[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report!

The potion subtype errors are non-fatal. TFMG and Create both register interpreters for Create’s potion fluids. JEI logs and ignores the second registration, then continues loading.

This crash is a duplicate of https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/issues/4450

This is an issue with Simulated, I submitted a fix for them here:
* https://github.com/Creators-of-Aeronautics/Simulated-Project/pull/1403
